legacy.source: OuYang et al. PPCF 67 (2025) 105004, doi:10.1088/1361-6587/ae0786; local digest
legacy.limitation: Published three-regime window classification, no crash score or CIs; counts disagree with stated accuracy; split grouping unspecified.

majority_baseline.selection: majority of natural fitting-shot windows, per fold

three_class_majority_baseline.selection: majority of natural fitting-shot windows, per fold

three_class_observed_majority_baseline.selection: argmax of pooled OOF true class support; descriptive class imbalance, not a fitted or deployable baseline; no val/test or expert scores used
three_class_observed_majority_baseline.bootstrap_class_policy: pooled OOF class chosen once and fixed through all 1000 shot resamples

three_class_window_protocol.class_selection: period median on fitting shots, per fold

expert.note: Three-fold ensemble; thresholds are means of inner selections. Per-shot scores without bootstrap because n=3. Exploratory spans were anchored to prior rule suggestions; no independent point crash times or spatial validation.

Three-fold ensemble; thresholds are means of inner selections. Per-shot scores without bootstrap because n=3. Exploratory spans were anchored to prior rule suggestions; no independent point crash times or spatial validation.

protocol.primary: three-fold out-of-fold on fixed train; 20% whole-shot inner selection from each outer training fold
protocol.interval_threshold: selected independently per fold on inner selection shots, grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.05
protocol.expert: reviewed shots excluded from fitting and selection; per-shot results without bootstrap
protocol.bootstrap: 1000 OOF shot resamples, seed 20261003; 512 probability bins for AUROC/AP
protocol.assessment: OOF pseudolabel scores intersect observable & assessed. Exploratory review scores intersect anchored reviewed spans & observable; spans were drawn while reviewing old rule suggestions. conditional algorithm-assessed scores also reported.
protocol.input_parity: saw-hl3: per-shot geometry/profile core and outer ECE averages, Mirnov mean 0-1 and Ip; saw-ours: all 48 ECE channels. Adapted HL-3 ECE inputs replace published SXR; architecture and input access differ.
protocol.inputs: one observability-only masking policy in fitting and inference; assessment masks affect supervision and scoring only
protocol.sampling: both models: half natural random windows, half crash-centred windows balanced over available period classes per fitting shot
protocol.validation_status: unvalidated algorithmic labels; reviewed spans are exploratory, anchored to prior rule suggestions, and have no point crash truth
